export.title: Export
export.description: Before reinstalling this server, download all Claude conversations as one file.
export.encryptDescription: The file contains your full chat history. A protected file can only be imported here, with the password; a forgotten password cannot be recovered.
export.started: Downloading {{fileName}}. A large history can take a while.
export.passwordTooShort_one: The password needs at least {{count}} character.
export.passwordTooShort_other: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
export.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
export.includes: Included: Claude transcripts, project memory, code checkpoints, task lists, images attached to chats, chat titles, archive, drafts, scheduled messages and preferences, artefacts (spreadsheets, documents and whiteboards), and Claude's user settings (settings.json without keys, CLAUDE.md, commands, agents, skills, output styles).
export.excludes: Not included: the Claude sign-in, ClaudeWeb accounts and keys, plugin code and keys (only the list of plugins, to install them again), and project folders unless you choose them below.
export.projectFilesDescription: Adds the chosen folders as they are now, with their Git history. Large folders make a large backup; existing files are never replaced on import.
export.projectFilesNone: No project folders in the home folder.

import.description: After a reinstall and sign-in, drop the exported file here. Conversations that already exist are skipped, never overwritten.

import.userSettingsExisting: Every one of these files already exists here and is kept.
import.pathMissing: This folder does not exist on this server. The conversations can be read after the import, but to continue them, create the folder (or get the code back) first.
import.pathUnknown: The original folder of these files is not recorded in the backup.
import.space: Adds about {{required}}; {{free}} free on this server.
import.importingHint: This continues on the server even if you close this page.
import.skipped_one: Skipped {{count}} conversation that was already here.
import.skipped_other: Skipped {{count}} conversations that were already here.
import.doneHint: They are in the sidebar now, and can also be continued in a terminal with claude --resume.
